comparison_variable: original-source observed materials handling while stopped in active freight zone
fixed_conditions: same one-way road, marked freight curb segment and sign hours
same ego vehicle, parked pose, civil time, camera setup and surrounding traffic
same source acquisition; only requested material activity differs
native_source_requirements: original map and freight curb marking with zone boundary
original regulatory sign text and effective hours joined to civil time
original vehicle identity, position, speed and door state
original material object/person movement and passenger exchange when present
original material-transport vehicle wait/entry state and spatial interaction
600 original Native frames joined to all four source cameras

source_observation_terms_mapped.st.curb_zone: source-marked freight curb loading segment and Native map
source_observation_terms_mapped.dev.regulatory_sign: source sign text and effective-hours hash
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.condition_in_effect: sign hours joined to original civil local time
source_observation_terms_mapped.env.civil_time: original civil clock source for every Native frame
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.standing_or_parked: original position and observed speed in marked zone
source_observation_terms_mapped.ru.commercial_motor_vehicle: source class of any materials-transport vehicle waiting or entering
source_observation_terms_mapped.kin.extent: source material object extent and movement, not inferred from requested activity
source_observation_terms_mapped.sig.door_open: original door state when available; not sufficient to prove material transfer
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.approaching: material-transport vehicle waiting or about-to-enter state and motion
